Hello HeliumDeploy team,

Hi Suman,

Good morning, and thanks for your order.

Yes, we ship to India, and your order Shop···· is already set for your (address hidden). It is paid and nothing has gone out yet.

Your Bitfortun BS-4 ships on October 31, 2026, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plan goes with it. You will get the tracking number by email the day it leaves.

If anything else comes up, just reply here.

Sarah

Best regards,
